question: On what condition does the act of applying meditation become the operative factor after worship of the circle in this sequence of practice?
premises: Worship of the circle is performed as a prior act.
Meditation is applied for as long as a stated condition holds.
The application of meditation is presented as the ongoing action in sequence.
inference: The efficacy of the practice turns on sustained application of meditation following worship of the circle.
uncertainties: The precise temporal limit of yāvat remains contextually determined rather than fixed here.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the condition holds.
